the best performance has been achieved by MOCVD-growth, but the best performance has not yet been obtained.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the MBE-growth technique can provide HEMTs with similar performance to MOCVD-growth, and that the performance of MOCVD-gated devices is limited by a high gate leakage.
we have demonstrated that MBE-grown AlGaN/GaNs HEMTs are capable of delivering high output power and efficiency at Ka-band frequencies.
MBE and MOCVD AlGaN/Gan HEMTs can be used for high-power Ka-band applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
MBE-grown HEMT technology has the potential to achieve higher power densities than MOCVD-growth technology at high frequencies.
MOCVD-growth technology is now capable of producing high-power HEMTs for millimeter-wave applications.
